method: Scheduled Pillar Two 30-day news refresh (19 Nov 2026 HKT): WebSearch plus fetching primary official pages for OECD, HK IRD/LegCo, SG IRAS/MOF/SSO, and JP NTA. Items added only when date and content were confirmed against a fetched source.

coverage.OECD: Checked 19 Nov 2026: Central Record official PDF re-fetched and still current as at 1 May 2026; Qualified SbS Regimes still list only the United States from 1 January 2026. The OECD GloBE publications HTML and news pages returned Cloudflare 403 from this environment; WebSearch of those pages and of November 2026 OECD announcements found no new model rules, AG, GIR, Central Record or Full Legislative Review since catalogued items (plenary 30 Oct; GIR XML Schema v2.0 20 Oct; Romania STTR 2 Oct). Latest AG remains September 2026. The 4 Nov Tax Certainty Day announcement remains 2025 MAP/APA statistics, not a standalone GloBE document. Deloitte World Tax Advisor 13 Nov OECD item is that same Tax Certainty Day statistics release; the 20 Nov and 18 Nov WTA PDFs return 404, so 13 Nov is still the latest weekly issue. No standalone OECD GloBE document published since the 30 Oct plenary statement.
coverage.HK: Checked 19 Nov 2026: IRD What's New and GMT/HKMTT page fetched. Newest What's New item remains the 17 Nov List of Debt Instruments and Sovereign Bonds Eligible for Profits Tax Concession or Exemption (as at 30 June 2026), not Pillar Two. No new IRD What's New Pillar Two item after the catalogued 26 Oct Portal BIR82 filing / e-assessments (2–4 Nov entries remain CARF & Amended CRS, not Pillar Two). The 5 Nov LC Paper No. CB(1)1388/2026(01) remains the latest official HK Pillar Two item; the planned subsidiary legislation has not yet been gazetted (planned negative vetting Dec 2026, commencement Feb 2027). Opened the Inland Revenue (Amendment) (Crypto-Asset Reporting Framework and Amended Common Reporting Standard) Ordinance 2026 (Ord. No. 8 of 2026), signed by the Chief Executive on 12 Nov 2026 and gazetted on 13 Nov 2026: ss. 17–18 (Division 1, from 1 Jan 2027) only add a section 2 cross-reference to the Schedule 61 and 62 headings; s. 29 (Division 3 miscellaneous amendments, from gazette day) adds the 9 May 2025 Consolidated Commentary and Illustrative Examples to Schedule 64, not the 2026 GloBE documents. Those changes were not catalogued as a standalone Pillar Two item. PwC HK Tax News Flash still ends at Issue 19 (5 Nov); no public trace of Issue 20 was found (index and Issue 20 URL were blocked with 403, same as the known Issue 19 PDF). Deloitte World Tax Advisor still latest 13 Nov; its HK item is a REIT stamp-duty proposal, not Pillar Two. KPMG's November note is secondary coverage of the already-catalogued 5 Nov LegCo paper.
coverage.SG: Checked 19 Nov 2026: IRAS Latest Updates fetched (newest item is 18 Nov GST: Guide on Exports, not Pillar Two; latest Pillar Two e-Tax Guide still 30 Oct Third Edition), IRAS GloBE/DTT page (last updated 13 Oct 2026), IRAS Newsroom (newest 17 Nov item is a GST refund-fraud conviction, not Pillar Two), MOF newsroom (newest 12 Nov item is the Budget 2027 consultation; page last updated 17 Nov), and PwC Singapore Tax News (12 Nov entries are Budget 2027 consultation and FEDR; latest SG Pillar Two entries remain 4 Nov Act 23 and 30 Oct Third Edition) fetched. SSO Acts Supplement last updated 19 Nov 2026; Finance (Income Taxes) Act 2026 remains Act 23; later 2026 Acts 24–26 are Financial Services and Markets, Digital Infrastructure and Land Transport, not Pillar Two. MMT Act subsidiary-legislation view current as at 19 Nov 2026 still lists only S 1062/2024, S 1060/2024 and S 861/2025; no new 2026 MMT Regulations. Catalogued items unchanged. Deloitte World Tax Advisor 13 Nov SG item restates the already-catalogued QTI list.
coverage.JP: Checked 19 Nov 2026: NTA 新着情報 fetched through 18 Nov. New 18 Nov item is 新設法人が設立の日に通算グループから離脱する場合のその法人の事業年度及び青色申告の承認について（文書回答事例）, a consolidation-group / blue-return ruling, not Pillar Two. No Pillar Two items after the catalogued 21 Oct GIR AEOI partner list. 17 Nov sake-safety measures; 13 Nov sake-export statistics; 11 Nov driver recruitment; 9 Nov student tax-essay awards; 2 Nov tobacco hand-held stock tax; 30 Oct CbCR EOI partner-list update confirmed non-Pillar Two (CbCR ≠ GIR); 30 Oct e-Gov public comment on 法人税基本通達 is an art-depreciation threshold change, not Pillar Two. GIR EOI hub still points to the October 2026 (令和8年10月) partner list. The 9 Oct 趣旨説明 remains catalogued but falls before the rolling 30-day window starting 20 Oct. NTA グローバル・ミニマム課税関係 page and MOF グローバル・ミニマム課税の概要 page fetched; no new JP IIR/QDMTT/GIR administrative guidance or November 2026 MOF Pillar Two publications.
